entities.name: Ikenet
entities.description: Human acrobat from Morningbrook in northern Aerona, cast out when pregnant, who befriended the minotaurs of Hurloon.

entities.name: Hamu
entities.description: Minotaur who took Ikenet in and became her friend, and was chosen Consort by Makura.

entities.name: Makura
entities.description: Great Mother of the minotaurs of Hurloon.

entities.name: Herhoona
entities.description: Arrogant minotaur who won the wrestling contest and was executed.

events.summary: Evicted from Morningbrook, Ikenet goes to the Hurloon mountains to die but is found by Hamu, who cares for her.
events.quote: she was found by the minotaur Hamu

events.summary: Ikenet and Hamu dance in the annual contest, earning Makura's favor.
events.quote: Ikenet performed together with Hamu, earning the Great Mother Makura 's favor

events.summary: Herhoona wins the wrestling contest, but Makura chooses Hamu as Consort.
events.quote: Makura chose Hamu as her Consort once again

events.summary: Herhoona charges Makura and is executed by a Grandmother.
events.quote: executed by one of the Grandmothers for endangering a Mother and her child

relations.quote: he took her in and cared for her, and they became friends
allowing Hamu to meet his son Amahu
who earlier injured Hamu and threatened Ikenet
